proposal.idea: Aboard a generation ship whose living skeleton is grown from Spire Crystal, the crystal spine doesn't just hold memories the way tree rings hold seasons -- it's started growing rings for things that haven't happened yet. A cheerfully stubborn goblin investigator has to figure out whether the ship is remembering the future or quietly writing it.

locations.art_direction: A fantasy-tinged grotto deck where the spire's roots fan out like a tree's through nanopunk scaffolding, goblin-sized catwalks strung with lantern light between crystal buttresses.
locations.best_scene: an engineer presses a palm to warm crystal and hears, faintly, a dead crewmate's voice
locations.known_for: goblin engineers who read the spire's crystal growth rings like tree rings, each one holding a season's worth of the ship's memories
locations.local_rule: no one splices new crystal into the spire without an Investigator present to log what memory gets grown over
locations.title: The Hollow Reliquary

rewards.best_used_when: a buried memory needs to come out gently, in a form people will actually stop and listen to
rewards.catch: it only ever sings the memory as the spire chose to remember it, never as it actually happened
rewards.grants: a sliver of Spire Crystal wound through with clockwork gearing that plays back any memory grown into it as a sung aria
rewards.look: a palm-length sliver of pale crystal threaded with fine brass clockwork, tiny gears sunk into its facets, light pulsing along its internal fractures
rewards.name: Aria Shard

rewards.best_used_when: a haunting needs to be laughed at instead of run from
rewards.catch: the jokes get bleaker the closer the ghost is to the truth
rewards.grants: read the emotional residue left in a freshly grown crystal ring like tea leaves, dry commentary included
rewards.look: a freshly split crystal growth-ring lit from behind, its concentric bands smeared with faint coloured residue like oil floating on water
rewards.name: Ghost-Ring Reading

scenarios.setup: At The Spire That Remembers, in the goblin engineer grotto of the Hollow Reliquary, Vex Thistlewick finds a crystal growth ring already recording a memory that hasn't happened yet -- and has to decide whether to warn the crew or let the spire finish growing its prophecy.
scenarios.title: The Ring That Wasn't Grown Yet

proposal.title: The Spire That Remembers

vibe.art_direction: A towering faceted crystal spire growing straight through the generation ship's core decks, veins of nanite light pulsing upward like sap, goblin engineers dwarfed and glowing in its reflected light.
vibe.line: The ship's crystal spine keeps growing new memories -- by eating the crew's old ones.
vibe.title: The Spire That Remembers
